name: Merdeka Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A 21.1 km half-marathon held on August 23, 2026, at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 is a half-marathon race taking place on August 23, 2026, at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It is organized by JBSKL x KPM and offers a 21.1 km distance. Registration for this race is currently open, making it available for interested runners to sign up ahead of the event date.

research_highlights: The race starts and finishes at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur City Centre, an iconic downtown square.
The event is co-organised by Jabatan Belia dan Sukan WPKL and Kita Pelari Malaysia, with Pure Events and Persatuan Olahraga WP as technical organiser, supported by DBKL.
Race kit (bib, T-shirt, etc.) must be collected during a designated pick-up period before race day; kits will not be issued after that window closes.
The event is open to Malaysian residents and non-Malaysians with valid residency, age 5 and above, per official rules.
Race date is August 23, 2026 (Sunday), during Malaysia's Merdeka (independence) season, a period known for warm, humid conditions typical of KL in August.
